definitions.gloss: water resistance; water-resistant quality; waterproof property
definitions.explanation: The ability of a material or product to resist the penetration or effects of water. Used when describing the properties of fabrics, coatings, electronics, and other products.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐水性|たいすいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{耐水性|たいすいせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: It uses a highly water-resistant material.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{塗料|とりょう}→塗料：24548_toryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐水性|たいすいせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れている→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{屋外|おくがい}→屋外：04136_okugai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{使|つか}えます→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This paint has excellent water resistance, so it can be used outdoors for a long time.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{耐水|たいすい}→耐水：24232_taisui⟧ (water-resistant) and ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (property, quality). The {耐|たい}～⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ pattern is highly productive in Japanese for expressing resistance or durability: {耐熱性|たいねつせい} (heat resistance), ⟦{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}→耐久性：20042_taikyuusei⟧ (durability), {耐震性|たいしんせい} (earthquake resistance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耐水性|たいすいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have water resistance
- {耐水性|たいすいせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to excel in water resistance
- {耐水性|たいすいせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: highly water-resistant
- {耐水性|たいすいせい}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: water resistance test

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧: waterproof — implies complete water blocking, stronger than {耐水性|たいすいせい}
- ⟦{撥水|はっすい}→撥水：16444_hassui⟧: water-repellent — water beads and rolls off the surface
- ⟦{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}→耐久性：20042_taikyuusei⟧: durability — general resistance to wear, broader than just water
